decisionEvents.ret: "Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"Can we talk?" Diana sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? You're doing fine."
"Please — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? I can't keep going like this."
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"About what you make of all this — What do you make of all this? Really, friend."
"Can we talk?" Violet sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"About what you make of all this — What do you make of all this? Really."
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Can we talk?" Violet glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?"
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about? Ha."

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
«Hallo! Du... wie heißt du?» "Thank you?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
"Please — whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Can you do anything?"
"About the most useful thing you've learned — What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here? Just... be straight with me."
"What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
"Can we talk?" Naran sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Please — I can't shake it. I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. I need help. Please."
"About what scares you most — What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
They speak. You understand none of it. "Hello?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
"I'm going hungry — have you got anything to spare? Anything? My hands shake when I try to work."
"Between us — They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"Interesting — Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"About the food I needed — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it? You'll see."
"Can I tell you something? I don't actually know how to swim and I'm terrified someone will find out."
"What's this about? Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"About the food I needed — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"Can I tell you something? I've been skimming extra food. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."

"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About how you slept — Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"Can we talk?" Mobolaji sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"I hate to ask, but do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"About how you slept — Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline. That's the truth of it."

They speak. You understand none of it.
"Sure — What do you miss most? From before."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
They speak. You understand none of it. "Hello?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
"Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff."
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
They speak. You understand none of it.
"Can I tell you something? At night I cry quietly so no one hears. Makes sense to me."
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. My cut needs a second pair of hands. Could you take a look?"
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."

They speak. You understand none of it.
"What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"About the kindest thing someone's done for you — What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here? I mean it."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Adrianna?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all, friend."
"About the kindest thing someone's done for you — What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here? That is all."
"About what got you through the first week — What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"I asked Ashley about the sickness I'm fighting — Ashley's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I asked Moise about what got you through the first week — Moise's gone. What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Angela?"
Everything else is luxury. Breathing tomorrow is the whole game.
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"About whether you're angry — Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"About your first memory — What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"Can I just — Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
"I need a second opinion — and a second pair of hands. You've got both."
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"About the pantry run — still on my mind. I keep coming back to it."
"This wound — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you take a look?"
"I asked Diana about the pantry run — Diana's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I asked Diana about the funniest thing you've seen — Diana's gone. Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"About this wound — still need hands. Are you in?"
"Can I tell you something? At night I talk to someone who isn't there anymore."
"Can we talk?" Stan sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Water's almost gone — 9 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"Water's almost gone — 3 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"I asked Sanne about the creek water run — Sanne's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"Can we talk?" Kyung-mi sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Can we talk?" Kyung-mi glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?"
"We never finished talking about grief — we wandered off it, 3 days back. 'Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them.'"
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
"Can I tell you something? I saw something in the woods I'm not telling anyone about."
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't. Just... be straight with me."
"I asked Ashley about the pantry run — Ashley's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
"Water's almost gone — 8 liters. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"Please — whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. Can you do anything?"
"About teaching them something — Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Can we talk?" Aria shifts their weight. "I need something to do. Anything. Please."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. Water's almost gone — 1 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About teaching them something — Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't. I mean it."
"The cistern's nearly dry — 8 liters left. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"The cistern's nearly dry — 3 liters left. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"I asked Mobolaji about the creek water run — Mobolaji's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the creek water run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. We're down to 3 liters of clean water. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
Did you see what I brought back? Tell the others. Please — tell them.
"When's the last time you really laughed, friend?"
"The pantry's nearly bare. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember. Funny how that works."
"I asked Kyung-mi about the creek water run — Kyung-mi's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I asked Kyung-mi about the pantry run — Kyung-mi's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I asked Kyung-mi about the last time you laughed — Kyung-mi's gone. When's the last time you really laughed?"
"The creek water run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
I was an exterminator in Chicago, Illinois. Say it back to me sometime. I need to hear it stays true.
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"I asked Naran about the last time you laughed — Naran's gone. When's the last time you really laughed?"
"I asked Aria about the last time you laughed — Aria's gone. When's the last time you really laughed? Makes sense to me."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"About the last time you laughed — When's the last time you really laughed?"

"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. The cistern's nearly dry — 4 liters left. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the last time you laughed — When's the last time you really laughed? Worth considering."
"About the last time you laughed — When's the last time you really laughed? Simple as that."
"Well — Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
"About what you believe in — Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
If we forget who we were, then what survived? Just bodies. I want more than that.
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Can I be honest? People are smiling. I forgot what that looked like."

"I hate to ask this, but whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. I need help. Please."

"Don't laugh yet — Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I stole from someone who trusted me. I think about it every day."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the east treeline."

"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I'm sorry — I can't shake it. I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Can you do anything?"
"I asked Chloe about the sickness I'm fighting — Chloe's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone."
"Can I tell you something? I've been sneaking out at night. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"The cistern's nearly dry — 5 liters left. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"Water's almost gone — 1 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"I asked Darnell about the creek water run — Darnell's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"

Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.
